quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Bianca Kennedy, Director of Events, is the primary commercially relevant organizer contact; the official exhibitor-sales page also directs enquiries to her. Tom Ly, Events Specialist, is the second operational contact and an appropriate routing contact for accommodation logistics. Samantha Nagy, Senior Events Marketing Specialist, is an additional route for a future hotel-listing discussion. Their current official emails use hrai.ca. None is publicly identified as the hotel-contract signatory or housing buyer; relevance is based on show-management roles, not proven procurement authority.
findings.futureEdition: Officially announced activity dates: March 22–24, 2028, Toronto, Ontario, Canada. The homepage and About page identify this edition explicitly; it is within the requested horizon. These are show dates, not publication dates. The March 25–27, 2026 edition has already concluded.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specifications: Radisson Blu Toronto Downtown is a city/Harbourfront lodging option for a limited delegate, exhibitor, speaker or executive sub-block, not the principal expo venue or exclusive convention hotel. Historical 2026 scale was 12,450 unique attendees and 17,295 participants including exhibitor representatives, far beyond a 157-room hotel. A roughly 15–109 peak-room sales target is a hotel-capacity planning range supplied in the brief, not published CMPX demand. MTCC proximity supports the lodging thesis; no verified walking time or room conversion is claimed. Small side meetings could be explored within the supplied room capacities, but catering/reception offers require restaurant, lounge and banquet-service verification first. Resort positioning is not the relevant use case.
findings.venueCommitments: Published 2028 venue: Metro Toronto Convention Centre, South Building, 222 Bremner Boulevard, Toronto, Ontario M5V 3L9, Canada. This is Toronto proper, downtown/MTCC territory, not an airport or suburban venue and not a competing hotel. The official listing establishes an announced venue commitment, not disclosure of a signed venue contract or lodging allocation.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified biennial series, not annual: the organizer says “Held every two years.” Retrieved editions remain in Toronto at MTCC: 2018 North Building; 2020 canceled; 2022 MTCC; 2024 moved to South Building; 2026 South Building; 2028 South Building announced. HPAC explicitly describes 2024 as the first South Building edition. No destination rotation is evidenced by this timeline; 2022 building is not asserted from a generic venue address.
findings.accommodationSourcing: The official page says “Our 2028 travel offers aren’t quite ready for takeoff. Check back soon for updates!” It also states “CMPX does not work with third-party housing agencies or booking agents” and instructs visitors to “book accommodations directly through the official hotel booking links provided on this page.” The ten dated offers still displayed are for 2026, not 2028 commitments: Fairmont Royal York; Residence Inn Toronto Downtown; Delta Hotels by Marriott Toronto; Toronto Marriott City Centre; Westin Harbour Castle; InterContinental Toronto Centre; Sheraton Centre Toronto; Hilton Toronto Airport Hotel & Suites; Toronto Airport Marriott Hotel; Sheraton Toronto Airport Hotel & Conference Centre. The first seven are downtown options; the final three are airport-area options, including Hilton in Mississauga. No additional hotel names appear in the page’s walking-distance list. This is evidence of historical official hotel offers/direct booking, not proof of contracted room quantities. No 2028 host hotel, housing bureau, published room block, open hotel RFP, booking cutoff or allocation is verified. Sourcing status remains unconfirmed, not open.
findings.organizationStructure: Association-led, jointly co-produced by the Heating, Refrigeration and Air Conditioning Institute of Canada (HRAI) and Canadian Institute of Plumbing & Heating (CIPH). These are the co-producing associations, not the venue. Newcom Media announced its appointment as show manager in 2020, replacing Shield & Associates; historical CIPH records accordingly show Newcom contacts. Bianca Kennedy’s June 2026 announcement says HRAI is “bringing event management in-house” and that she is joining as Director of Events after managing its portfolio through Newcom. The current CMPX team page uses HRAI addresses. Route 2028 enquiries to the current team, not stale Newcom contacts; no separate current PCO, DMC or accommodation intermediary is verified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Historical competition is concrete: ten official 2026 hotel offers remain listed, with published historical rates of $199–$359/night. Fairmont Royal York is marked “Sold Out” against a March 2026 stay period; that is historical availability evidence for one offer only, not proof of citywide compression, Radisson overflow pickup, or a 2028 shortage. Radisson Blu is absent from that published list. The convention venue is not a hotel, so venue confirmation alone does not establish lodging is committed elsewhere. 2028 hotel commitments, exclusivity, allocation and pickup are unknown.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Bianca Kennedy first, copying Tom Ly, to ask who owns 2028 accommodation contracting, whether hotel selection is complete, when official offers will publish, and whether a 157-room Harbourfront property can submit a limited allotment. Ask for stay pattern, peak rooms, room nights, staff/speaker requirements and historical pickup before pricing. Offer a capped room-only or lodging-plus-small-meeting proposal subject to availability and verified services; do not promise exclusive housing, catering, pickup or overflow. If hotel selection is closed, request a permitted exhibitor-group referral or waitlist route and a future-cycle review date.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The accessible target is announced CMPX 2028; CMPX 2026 is historical and cannot be sold now. 2028 accommodation offers are not yet published and no open sourcing invitation is verified. Current access is an organizer conversation about the sourcing process and eligibility for an additional official hotel offer or exhibitor/speaker lodging, not a live RFP or guaranteed overflow lead.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: seek consideration in the 2028 official hotel programme before offers are published, or an organizer-approved exhibitor/speaker sub-block if the principal programme is already allocated. Historical multi-hotel direct booking provides a plausible pathway, not evidence that additional hotels are being accepted. For editions after 2028, retain a biennial relationship-development strategy only; no later dates, city or venue are asserted.
